tips.title: Brake before the bend
tips.tip: Ease off the gas before a corner, then speed up on the way out. You'll be quicker than if you slam the brakes halfway through.

tips.title: Find your favourite ride
tips.tip: Every car handles differently. Sports cars grip well, while big trucks and vans are slow to turn. Try a few and see which one suits you.

tips.title: Race smart
tips.tip: Keep an eye on the checkpoints and the map. Knowing where the next turn is matters more than top speed. Crashed? Get straight back on track and stay calm.

tips.title: Mod shop upgrades
tips.tip: At the mod shop you can change paint and wheels, and upgrade the engine, brakes and tyres. Spend your in-game money on the car you drive most.

tips.title: Road trip!
tips.tip: The map is huge. Try driving to the mountains, the beach or the countryside just for the views. And save your game often so you don't lose progress.

tips.title: Stay safe online 🛡️
tips.tip: Never share your password, full name, school, address or phone number, even with game 'friends'. If someone is mean or weird, block and report them, then tell Dad.

tips.title: No such thing as free Robux
tips.tip: Anyone offering 'free Robux' or asking for your password is trying to scam you. Only buy things from the official Roblox store or inside the game.

tips.title: Obby jumping
tips.tip: Line up your jump first by moving the camera so you can see your feet. Run and jump right at the edge of the platform. Slow and steady beats rushing!

tips.title: Studio starter
tips.tip: Roblox Studio is free and lets you make your own games. Start with simple parts, shape them with the Move, Scale and Rotate tools, and press Play to test often.

tips.title: Anchor it!
tips.tip: In Studio, 'Anchor' any part that shouldn't move, otherwise it will fall or tumble when you press Play. Ready for more? Roblox games are coded in Lua (Luau).

tips.title: The four builds
tips.tip: The basic builds are wall, floor, stairs (ramp) and roof (cone). Practise switching between them fast. Creative mode is perfect for practising with no pressure.

tips.title: Pick your material
tips.tip: Wood builds fastest but is weakest. Brick is in the middle. Metal is slowest to build but toughest once it's finished.

tips.title: Beat the storm
tips.tip: Watch the storm timer on your map and start moving toward the safe zone early. Rushing at the last second is risky. Collect materials along the way.

tips.title: Edit like a pro
tips.tip: Editing lets you add windows, doors and arches to your builds. Practise edits in Creative until they feel quick and smooth.

tips.title: Make your own island
tips.tip: In Creative you can build a race track, a parkour course or even a basketball court. Try other players' parkour maps to improve your movement.

tips.title: Look ahead, not at your bumper
tips.tip: When you're racing or cruising, keep your eyes a few corners ahead on the mini-map. Spotting the next turn early means you can brake smooth and keep more speed.

tips.title: Camera is your friend
tips.tip: In most Roblox games, hold right-click (or use the right stick) to look around while you move. Seeing what's coming helps a lot in parkour and adventures.

tips.title: Land with a plan
tips.tip: Before you jump from the Battle Bus, pick a spot on the map. Quiet edges often mean easier loot and time to gear up before you meet other players.

tips.title: Smooth braking beats slamming
tips.tip: Ease off the accelerator before a corner, then brake gently. Slamming the brakes locks the wheels and you slide past the turn. Smooth in, fast out!

tips.title: Shift lock for precision
tips.tip: In many Roblox games, turn on Shift Lock (or first-person) so you turn with the camera. It makes parkour jumps and aiming feel much tighter.

tips.title: Listen before you peek
tips.tip: Sound tells you a lot — footsteps, chests, and builds. Pause for a second near a building and listen before you rush in.

tips.title: Coast into corners
tips.tip: Ease off the throttle before a bend so the car stays planted — smooth in, speedy out.

tips.title: Hotbar heroes
tips.tip: Pin your favourite tools on the hotbar so you can grab them fast without digging through the backpack.

tips.title: Ping, don't shout
tips.tip: Tap to mark what you see for your squad — a quick ping is clearer than yelling across the room.

tips.title: Check your mirrors
tips.tip: Before you change lanes, glance in your mirrors and check over your shoulder. Knowing what's behind you keeps the race smooth and the car on track.

tips.title: Jump + sprint timing
tips.tip: For long parkour gaps, start sprinting a step early, then jump at the edge. Too early and you fall short; too late and you clip the ledge.

tips.title: Land near mats
tips.tip: Touch down close to trees, cars, or walls so you can farm wood and metal right away — early mats mean safer rotates later.

tips.title: Short shifts, big grip
tips.tip: In a race, tap the handbrake only for a quick snap-turn — holding it too long makes the rear slide and you lose time.

tips.title: Stuck? Reset smart
tips.tip: If you're wedged in a wall or falling forever, use the Reset / Respawn button instead of quitting the whole game.

tips.title: Reload behind cover
tips.tip: Duck behind a wall or rock before you reload. An empty clip in the open is the quickest way to get sent back to the lobby.

tips.title: Ride at your own pace
tips.tip: Every jump needs the right speed: too fast and you overshoot, too slow and you come up short. It's totally fine to brake before a big jump, and watch the drone fly-over at the start of a track to spot what's coming.

tips.title: Bunny hop like a pro
tips.tip: Hold the right stick down to load up, then push it up to hop. Push up when you're higher up the ramp and you'll fly higher!

tips.title: Soft, flat landings
tips.tip: Try to land with both wheels together, and push the right stick up as you touch down to soak up the hit. It helps you ride away from big drops instead of bailing.

tips.title: Earn back your health
tips.tip: Every bonus objective you finish gives you +1 life. Medic Camp tracks give a life just for finishing, plus another for their bonus, so visit one when you're running low!

tips.title: Head for the Boss Jump
tips.tip: On the map, pick tracks that lead toward the Boss Jump. After about 7 tracks it starts getting dark, so don't wander too long. Grab the checkpoint just before the Boss Jump so you can retry it.

tips.title: Mix tricks for Rep
tips.tip: Press L1 with a stick direction to do tricks and earn Rep. Doing the same trick again gives less, so mix it up! At 1,000 Rep you pick your first crew member, and Landing Impact is a great choice.

tips.title: Pump for free speed
tips.tip: On rollers and small bumps, push down into the dip then pull up as you rise — that's pumping. You gain speed without pedalling, and it helps you clear the next jump.

tips.title: Hit the racing line
tips.tip: In a race, enter wide, clip the inside of the corner (the apex), then exit wide again. That smoother curve keeps more speed than hugging the inside the whole way.

tips.title: High ground helps
tips.tip: Stairs or a ramp to higher ground make it easier to see what's coming and harder for others to reach you. Build up early when you can, then peek carefully.

tips.title: Eyes up the trail
tips.tip: Look a few metres ahead down the trail, not at your front wheel. You'll spot rocks, turns and jumps early and have time to pick a smooth line.

tips.title: Laggy game? Lower the graphics
tips.tip: Open Roblox Settings, set Graphics Mode to Manual and slide Graphics Quality down a few notches. It looks a bit simpler but runs much smoother.

tips.title: Switch your camera view
tips.tip: While driving, press the camera button (the touchpad on PlayStation) to cycle views. A further-back view helps you see corners and traffic coming in races.

tips.title: Low on lives? Pick a calmer track
tips.tip: Before you choose the next track on the map, check its info: some are steeper or have bigger jumps. If you're down to your last life, pick the calmer one to keep your run going.

tips.title: Star your favourites ⭐
tips.tip: Found a game you love? Tap the star (Favourite) on its page. It's saved in your Favourites so you can find it again in a second next time.

tips.title: Heal up before you move on
tips.tip: After a close call, find a safe spot and top up your health and shield before running to the next area. Starting fresh beats rushing in with low health.

tips.title: Brake before the corner, not in it
tips.tip: Slow down on the straight bit BEFORE a sharp turn, then let off the brake, lean and roll through. Braking hard in the middle of a corner is the quickest way to skid out and lose health. 🚵

tips.title: Handbrake for hairpins
tips.tip: Super-tight hairpin bend? Ease off the gas and tap the handbrake (R1 on PlayStation) to swing the back of the car round, then straighten up and accelerate out. Just a tap, holding it too long spins you out! 🏎️

tips.title: Drop a map marker 📍
tips.tip: Open the map and place a marker where you want to go. A line on your compass points you there, and your squad can see it too, so everyone knows the plan without shouting.

tips.title: Bonus objectives = extra lives ❤️
tips.tip: Before a track starts, check its bonus objective (like landing some tricks). Finish it during the run and you earn an extra life, which helps you get further down the map.

tips.title: Set a waypoint 📍
tips.tip: Open the map, pick where you want to go and set a waypoint. A line shows the best route on your mini-map, so you can enjoy the drive instead of getting lost.

tips.title: Jump back in with Continue
tips.tip: The Continue row on the Roblox home screen shows games you played recently, so you can get back to your favourite one in one tap.
